scope: Direct full-module context review; original inventoried site start positions joined to explicit semantic contexts, not independent expression-level or runtime certification. T temporal/state/order, P price/priority, N declaration/other.

contexts.meaning: Imports, module path bootstrap conditional insertion, version constants, 400-candle MBL extension, Tehran timezone and context-local progress sink.
Set progress sink, always restore token in finally.
Emit status/label/details and optional duration rounded to 2 decimals; call sink or compact stderr flush; failures propagate.
Start timing/progress before try; work result returned, finally accumulates label duration and emits completion; no price transformation.
Dynamic module spec and loader required; register module before execution. Fixed reaction name wrapper.
Epoch/local conversion caches; epoch-to-Tehran then naive; reverse attaches Tehran and truncates timestamp to int. Display datetime direct or parsed string cached.
Input traversal original order; int raw timestamp and normalized O/H/L/C; consecutive equal lower timestamps update extrema/close preserving first open; new timestamp creates new bucket.
lower_only skips main; main key timestamp for TF1 otherwise floor division*TF. Consecutive equal main key same aggregation; no global sorting or gap fill; equal extrema first wins.
Normalize Decimal per exact type/value cache; first normalized representation retained on equal key; native error propagation.
BucketAppend immutable dirty/settled position record.
Live timeframe exact int>=1; shared main/lower lists for TF1, initial last time null and price cache empty; append delegates transaction.
Dirty begins old lengths; empty append yields delta only. Equal first time to prior last copies dirty lower tail; same first bucket copies dirty main tail. TF1 dirty main=lower.
Live checked rows integer conversion must equal original and >0; time nondecreasing, equality permitted. Local previous updated as rows yielded.
Prior price cache then new per-append cache; Decimal normalization only on miss.

Aggregate validated input into temporary tails before mutation. Snapshot old suffixes/time, install new price cache entries and bucket suffixes, update last time. On BaseException during yield restore suffixes/time and delete new price keys; rethrow.
Dirty positions supplied; settled exclusive counts max(0,len-1) for each series, last remains mutable.
Build candle positions by enumerate from supplied start; Tehran local datetime/display, native classify open/close, normalized OHLC retained.
Live views hold mutable lists and indexes; no data initially.
Replace suffix from dirty or zero if index absent; rebuild index if absent/capacity exceeded else refresh suffix. TF1 main aliases lower list/index, otherwise independent refresh.
If either bound null accept; else inclusive source index after int.
Reset selection by index, Reaction by First, both original order; transform selected reactions only; retain raw/public pairs.
Use supplied selection or compute. Reset second nullable, price strings, display epochs; reaction public geometry and positions, no additional chronological filter.
Blue serializer source selection via inclusive range helper; nullable Fibonacci/broken level; timestamps epoch, prices strings.
A rows preserve Blue ordinals, source/stop/trigger/reaction fields, exact trigger event and price strings; calculationValid=true; no filtering.
S rows retain native A provenance and optional Order/Reset times/prices, exact decision; calculationValid=true; no filtering.
E rows retain required parent/Order geometry, causes list and optional parent cause event, exact decision. No validity field added.
StopAll rows retain gate and stopped behavior separate from nullable Order and own stop fields; no donor fields in legacy; own stop times truthiness guard.
Bridge datetime null/string unchanged, non-datetime null, local formatted datetime; title direction, mode A/B mapping, color null/empty or title.
View horizon last visible main open+TF; nonnull event strictly before horizon.

Strict-event proof rejects absent/out-of-horizon event or level. Normalize price, bisect left exact timestamp, scan only equal timestamp rows. Bearish High>level else Low<level. Return same recorded event or null, no substitute search.
Absent/out-of-horizon main stop -> both null; otherwise main formatted, event independently proven.

Reaction confirmation helper with configurable intrabar start; caught specified access/index/type/value errors -> null. Prove selected level using opposite direction strict stop predicate; no new event selection.
Physical Order identity only if both indexes nonnull, normalized ints.
Projection maps accepted audit identity last-wins; retains references without ownership changes.
Physical Order null/invalid First or Break bounds -> null. Actual main times from positions; exact confirmation proven, known crossed tuple optional; stop level and horizon proof.
Parent formation Order lookup exact identity in final audit, otherwise null.

Current creator Order requires known strict stop and source. Parent-stop exact label/source/event plus family (null permits null/empty). Reset-leg compatible exact post type or base E/StopAll prefix, exact source/stop. Unknown cause ignored. Exactly one distinct physical match required; conflicts null.
Audit projection requires valid physical formatter else RuntimeError. Convert parent-stop and reset-leg known causes, preserve other values, skip unknown kinds.
Parent stop delegation if detector; specified errors or null result/invalid index -> null pair. Actual helper called, no independent search here; may execute authoritative parent_stop.
A first stop delegated to S detector with price and A confirmation; specified exceptions/null -> null pair. Return authoritative main/exact time.
Combine stop proof with string price.
Non-scale Blue source time/no event. Scale needs 1-based valid ordinal and Break bounds, uses main Break and exact proof with intrabar start disabled.
Reaction projection uses raw First/Break candles and public top/bottom geometry; raw exact confirmation proof.
Reset uses recorded display/second and previous First main when valid index.
Blue formation mapping and source extreme; stop main/event null by design, brokenLevel only reset.
Full Blue sort reaction number,source time,kind, enumerate 1-based; invalid/internal not filtered here.

A joins recorded full Blue ordinals; missing lines null. A stop and exact proof, Reaction lookup 1-based; ordinary/double-stop mapping; Blue stop views from retained evidence, reaction proof disables intrabar. Current Order exact A cause only.
S own stop delegated, proof; formation mapping only Blue, Red null. Parent A recorded source/stop and physical formation Order; current exact S/color cause.
Source join requires both source index/time; int index.
E parent physical identity join by type S/E/StopAll; color/number null when missing; recorded parent source/price/stop retained.
E stop delegated, proven strict event, parent and formation Order, current exact E number/family cause.
StopAll gate type formation mapping; own event proof; donor metadata retained separately, donor stop not group gate. Current exact numbered StopAll null-family cause.
Audit display key epoch First/Break.

Projection obtains actual selected lists and detector direction or opposite fallback; full Blue ordinals, historical accepted S/E/StopAll source maps; selected E/StopAll override same identity. Eight arrays map exact selected objects, no additional ownership/filter.

Validate physical identity presence for public S/E/StopAll only when both Order indexes supplied. Missing collected -> RuntimeError. Exact parent-stop tuple label/family/event/source has one physical owner; repeated same owner allowed, conflicting raises.
Legacy audit rows with public ordinal truthy override, physical times, nullable exact stop, known cause types; sort First/Break epoch.
EngineBundle and MarketContext declarations, index offset and initial flags.

Independent segment requires 0<=start<stop<=len. Main slice [start,stop), lower [first main timestamp,next main timestamp or last+TF), reindex both from zero, rebuild chronology. Visible bounds clipped, offset increases; initial flags inherited only at start0 unless explicitly supplied.
Recursively offset exact nonnegative int values for index or *Index keys, physical/reset identity components; preserve other scalars including bool and timestamps.
Transition uses actual source and exact event, PH3/PL3 owner, absolute index; icon source+49 if exists else null; physical price string.
CLI required paths/aliases/data/timeframe/from/to/direction; E/lifecycle optional; display/primary flags enabled default, bridge opt-in, raw timeframe default1. Timeframe/raw>=1.
Load configured engines once in order Reaction,Blue,A,S,optional E; lifecycle default path always loaded, primary fixed path if enabled (missing attr disabled).
Read complete source bytes, remove BOM, parse Decimal floating lexemes, delegate rows.
Full raw context regardless requested view; empty rows reject; aggregate both series except lower_only TF1.
Batch builds lower views/shared index then main alias TF1 or separate; live updates prepared views and supplies exact indexes to chronology.
Visible bounds floor epoch-aligned requested from/to (TF1 unchanged); lower_bound start, lower_bound(end+TF)-1, reject missing/reversed, clamp last. No calculation truncation.
PipelineState and FullDirectionState store authoritative vs candidate maps and shared stage references.

E detector full bounds 0..last; trend/opposite native reactions and resets, S evidence, accepted initial ledger, block/exceptions, invalid roots, B legs and shared priority. Direct geometry chooses live callback or native gate method. Live scope kwargs only if continuation supplied.

Full direction first pass Blue then A then S with full bounds, opposite resets/geometry. Live alternatives optional. Keep initial S snapshot. Feedback shared stages reuse Blue/A/S detector and initial S, not previous E. Snapshot candidates.
Initial E only accepted S-eligible A audit sources; detect with B legs. S lifecycle eligibility length change triggers blocked source times (set or TypeError list fallback), repeat E with valid S.

Compute visible candidate A but validate all eligible A against provisional S candidates and E (no StopAll). Exact stop callbacks; derive invalid A physical identities and S descendants by A source time.
Remove only stage-invalid S descendants before next E calculation; general invalid S retained as evidence until final removal.

Accepted A sources exclude invalid physical identities. Resolve Order context using original S audit, blocked First, pending S sources, source-time A stop callback, exact accepted E stop events and opposite confirmation; collect E exceptions.
Recreate final E with accepted audit, block exceptions, invalid S, B legs; detect.
Shared Order stops only accepted A/E ledger entries. If S changes update candidate list by (A source time,S source time), recreate E once with same accepted context.

Consumed-S evidence excludes stage-invalid candidates; preserve independent accepted A physical identities. Match current E owner by physical source index/time; missing skip; replace via native earlier continuation.
Rebuild accepted audit from actual final E and supplemental consumed S; remove all invalid S from accepted list, retain candidate and initial lists.

Feedback at most eight passes, start empty B legs/seen; save first shared stages. Optional StopAll uses same flag as final. Restore independent roots, ensure ledger then rediscover exact B causes. Equal signature returns original state of pass; repeated non-equal or exhaustion raises; no arbitrary convergence.
Directions both -> bullish,bearish; any Blue/A/S enabled requires both Reaction directions. Full context iff E and S enabled; initialize state maps.
Full geometry detectors both directions over full history with own initial flags; batch detect or live; derive internal ownership; optional report callback.

Capture opposite direction in initial geometry callback, native or live. Full behavior both if primary loaded else requested; run feedback per direction with explicit lifecycle-path flag; store maps, optional report.
Nonreusable uses directional initial A-stop finder; native full-history Reaction required directions and optional ownership; otherwise empty identity sets. Return state.
Range and visibility state records, projection snapshots separate from final arrays.
Blue required for Blue/A/S enabled; reusable clips full Blue by source inclusive, else detect on full reactions; A required for A/S similarly.
S enabled full mode uses full candidates/accepted S and full S-eligible A (replaces clipped A). Nonfull builds S full bounds and detects; A becomes eligible. E full copy, invalid sets retained.
Final initial A visibility and S-stop filters; E copy. Independent root restoration supplements only missing physical E sources as StopAll donors, not replacements of accepted donor geometry.
StopAll only explicit lifecycle path AND E AND S enabled and detector present; reconcile with optional live finder.

If E detector restore independent roots, ensure audit; select visibility stop by S-like attribute; rediscover B legs with final sources and require exact signature equality with converged legs; register. Else S first_a_stop from exact decision.
Capture accepted S/E/StopAll references before final lifecycle/visibility clipping; final visibility receives candidates, invalid S, native stop and candidate event callbacks, all A.
Primary groups before range clipping (A excludes invalid identity). Public A/S/E/StopAll clip source inclusive; filter invalid A/S physical identities.
Audit accepted A source times from full S eligible list excluding invalid, not clipped. Mark internal Blue using all behavior reactions; lifecycle internal output helper applied.

Required Order identities from displayed S/E/StopAll with both indexes. Prepare visible audit plus required identities, validate if E detector. Public Blue delegated, return final and projection snapshots.
Legacy-only direct serializer path; Reaction transform published candidate; Blue/A flags affect output only, other arrays from visibility, audit if detector.
Bridge-enabled shared exact Reaction selection, Blue enabled+source-range, A enabled, S/E/StopAll retained, audit sorted physical First/Break. Both legacy and additive projection share selections.
Primary Order separates conceptual owner and physical direction, cause type order A then B, audit datetime->epoch/Decimal->str, native geometry/time/stop and nullable box.

Resolve final primary side through visible end (bullish lows, else highs). Cycles fallback singleton. Cycle id offset only four-part format; point id uses identity origin absolute trigger/decision and optional later cycle suffix; actual row local indexes.

Primary points require visible source inclusive AND decision<=end. Visible cycles need MBL trigger<=end; formed legs through horizon, no source clipping. Cap at source+400 actual candle or extrapolate after last by TF; stop fields only if nonnull index<=end.
Primary side resolved, secondary raw; aggregate cycleIds by exact physical source and decision<=end, stable dedup. Cycle rows only visible and id nonnull, counts and primary IDs from selected rows.

Post-secondary3 orders from visible cycles stop_index<=end; status latest visible cycle else qualification strictly before horizon -> waiting-for-stopall-break, otherwise waiting-for-matching-behaviors.
Finalize opposite direction for full primary groups. Both owner audits full range accepted noninvalid A. Callback register primary low/high then refresh owner full audit.
Native primary resolver and appropriate detection/live path; reconcile primary labels resolved through visible end; preserve existing visible audit identities as required and rebuild audit.

Range state then final visibility. Primary owner bearish for both else requested; requires primary, E detector and explicit lifecycle path. Save result, resolve StopAll ownership through end, validate audit; serialize then primary arrays.
Group independent regime segments by direction in encounter order; single unchanged; multi copy last scalar metadata, concatenate list fields and bridge arrays, remove aggregate end, retain segments.

Reversal starts prior opposite target; local args copy/direction, independent calculation and optional continuation. Publish absolute indexes, noninitial start metadata, incoming transition. Stopped prefix end at transition main time, status/cycle status and min leg cap.

Require strictly advancing boundary within context. Closed prefix [0,boundary), if no visible history calculate whole prefix internally; resolve primary through actual prefix end; finally release indexes. Optional live closed cache.

Require independent confirmed Primary3 same source time and price as transition. If no visible history recursively empty lists; publish stopped prefix. Incoming transition serialized in prior context; new segment includes boundary with target initial flag; compute with optional live active regime, finally release indexes. Stop when no next transition or beyond visible end.
Response versions/flags/actual visible times and direction arrays in requested order.
Visible transition index<=end replaces directions with independent regimes. Active direction max (calculationStartIndex default -1,direction), default target.

Repair horizon through last visible main open+TF-1s. closed_through=min(epoch(through)+1,last lower epoch+raw_timeframe default1); StopAll confirmation closed iff decisionTime+TF<=closed_through. Apply T/F per segment; merged list rows share references. Timings rounded only.
Scope clears three timestamp caches and optional shared indexes before yield and finally; no market execution proof.
Live RAW and buckets entry delegate common runner, bucket view/delta inputs included.
Common live runner prepares market, optional ready callback, prepares state with report_stage but no live continuation argument on this path, builds response, scope cleanup.

CLI validate telemetry, load, scoped market/state/response; calculation completion, compact JSON and encode telemetry, print exit0. Ordinary Exception prints error JSON exit1; not general BaseException catch.
